newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Cofap raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Cofap raised to buy.

text.p: -- Bear, Stearns & Co said on Tuesday it had raised its rating for Brazil's Companhia Fabricadora de Pecas, or Cofap, to buy from neutral at an opening price of $14.60 per Level-1 American Depositary Receipt (ADR).

-- "Cofap, Brazil's largest supplier of auto parts, is enjoying the benefits of recent cost-cutting measures which have resulted in three consecutive quarters of operating margin improvements, leaving it leaner and more efficient and allowing it to return to profitability after a difficult 1995," analyst David Wheeler wrote in a report.
-- The firm set a 12-month price target of $22 for its Level-1 ADRs.
